men's basketball tournament|2023]]) }} '''Andre Terrell Jackson Jr.''' (born November 13, 2001) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]] of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Early life and high school career== Jackson grew up in [[Amsterdam (city), New York|Amsterdam, New York]] and attended [[The Albany Academy]].{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-clb-uconn-men-andre-jackson-20191004-20191003-ezgzvt4vkfgwzl2fhfb36n7g5q-story.html|title=Meet Andre Jackson: Things to know about the newest UConn men's basketball player|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=October 3, 2019|last=Amore|first=Dom|access-date=March 7, 2023}} Jackson played on the United States select team in the 2018 [[Albert Schweitzer Tournament]].{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/1808115/2020/05/12/hes-like-a-leopard-coaches-rave-about-what-andre-jackson-brings-to-uconn/|title=‘He’s like a leopard’: Coaches rave about what Andre Jackson brings to UConn|first=Charlotte|last=Carroll|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=May 12, 2020|access-date=March 7, 2023}} He averaged 18.8 points, 10.1 rebounds, 5.1 assists, and three steals per game during his senior season and was named the New York Sports Writers Association Class A Player of the Year.{{cite web|url=https://dailygazette.com/2020/04/23/albany-academy-basketball-s-jackson-is-nysswa-class-a-player-of-year/|title=Albany Academy basketball's Jackson is NYSSWA Class A Player of Year|work=[[The Daily Gazette]]|date=April 23, 2020|last=Kelly|first=Michael|access-date=March 7, 2023}} Jackson committed to playing college basketball for [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] over offers from [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]], [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]], [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]], and [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/27753291/espn-100-andre-jackson-commits-uconn-huskies|title=ESPN 100 Andre Jackson commits to UConn|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=October 2, 2019|access-date=March 7, 2023}} ==College career== Jackson played in 16 games during his freshman season at UConn and averaged 2.7 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-amore-column-uconn-men-liu-20211114-20211118-2lohwrvd65gezbkygcdhxg3cnu-story.html|title=Dom Amore: This is the Andre Jackson UConn men have been waiting for|first=Dom|last=Amore|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=November 18, 2021|access-date=March 7, 2023}} He missed seven games due to a broken left wrist.{{cite web|url=https://www.nhregister.com/uconn/article/UConn-freshman-Andre-Jackson-sidelined-15825266.php|title=UConn freshman Andre Jackson's broken wrist injury adds to tough week for Huskies|work=[[New Haven Register]]|date=December 23, 2020|last=Borges|first=David|access-date=March 7, 2023}} Jackson started all but one of the Huskies' games as a sophomore and averaged 6.8 points and 6.8 rebounds per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-uconn-men-andre-jackson-ready-to-lead-20220515-20220515-vjk3gyrq4zdzbnvtzhqm3t7uuu-story.html|title=After roster shakeup, UConn guard Andre Jackson is ready to take charge|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=May 15, 2022|access-date=March 7, 2023}} Jackson was named a team captain entering his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-amore-column-uconn-men-big-east-andre-jackson-team-captain-20221020-20221019-gbhb7vyiifbf3lbg7zk2hkgtae-story.html|title=Dom Amore: How Andre Jackson Jr. became the captain Dan Hurley never knew he needed for UConn men's basketball|first=Dom|last=Amore|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=October 19, 2022|access-date=March 7, 2023}} He missed the first three games of the season after fracturing the pinky finger on his right hand during preseason practices.{{cite web|url=https://sny.tv/articles/uconn-andre-jackson-jr-fractured-pinky-underwent-successful-surgery|title=UConn's Andre Jackson Jr. suffered fractured pinky, underwent successful surgery|first=Robert|last=Sanchez|website=[[SNY.tv]]|date=October 12, 2022|access-date=March 7, 2023}} Jackson started the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|2023 national championship game]] and scored three points with six assists, three rebounds, and two steals as the Huskies won 76–59.{{cite web|url=https://dailygazette.com/2023/04/04/amsterdams-jackson-played-big-role-in-uconns-national-championship-win/|title=Amsterdam's Jackson played big role in UConn's national championship
